title: The Look That Answers
source_seed: Seed 3 (devotional telling): in one telling of the Lalita story (Lalitopakhyana ch. 30, Lalita restores Kama), her compassionate look gives life back; dhyana verse 2, 'eyes full of waves of compassion'. The glance telling is secondary, not canonical.
logline: The camera moves in on her face as her composed look softens into compassion meeting the viewer, and her rose-gold glow brightens in answer.
hook: From the first second the camera glides toward her face while her steady eyes begin to soften.
story: The viewer is the one her compassion reaches. Her look softens, and her own radiance answers it, brightening her face, crown and jewels as her smile warms. Invented symbol: a faint soft sheen on the water below echoes her glow; it is our visual device, not from the texts.
loop: The glow eases and her expression rests in the gentle smile of frame 1, ready to restart.
share_trigger: Sent to someone who needs comfort: 'she looks at you and the light comes back'.
caption_hook: In one telling of the Lalita story, a single compassionate look gave life back. Watch it reach you.
audio: Solemn: low drone and a bowed tone, a gentle frame drum that quickens slightly at the glow. Tempo and references to come from the director (rule 8); no throat-singing, no war horn.

shots.camera: Eye level, a slow push-in from the full-length reference framing toward Her face, the tall crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed and the face clearly readable.
shots.action: Her composed look softens into compassion as Her eyes meet the viewer, Her brow easing and Her gentle smile deepening a little. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: Her gaze reaches the viewer first; the softening face is the action.

shots.camera: The slow eye-level push-in holds on Her face, the crown and crescent moon centered and fully framed.
shots.action: Her rose-gold glow brightens across Her face, crown and jewels in answer to Her look, Her smile warming, and a faint soft sheen spreads across the water below. Her hair settles under natural gravity.
shots.purpose: The visible consequence of Her compassion: Her radiance answers and the light returns.
